banners.askOwner: Ask an Owner to update the payment method.
banners.whiteLabel: White label stays until {date}, the end of the period you paid for. Then the default branding returns.

deletion.title: Delete the organization
deletion.description: Deleting is separate from canceling. The organization becomes read-only at once and its data is deleted after 7 days, with no 30-day export window. Any Owner can recover it during those 7 days. You confirm with your second factor.
deletion.ownerOnly: Only the Owner deletes the organization.
deletion.pendingBody: The organization is read-only. Its data is deleted after {date}, and the Owner receives a deletion certificate.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: Offer the organization to another member. They accept with their second factor within 7 days, and you stay the Owner until then. You confirm the offer with your second factor.
transfer.noMembers: Invite the person first. Ownership goes only to an active member who is not an Owner yet.
transfer.offered: Ownership offered. They have 7 days to accept.
transfer.open: Offered to {name} until {date}. You stay the Owner until they accept.

partner.leaveDescription: {org} becomes a direct customer. Its data, members and brand stay as they are. The support sessions and standing grants of {partner} end, and billing moves to {org}: the {plan} plan continues for 14 days and stays once you add a card.
partner.ownerOnly: Only the Owner moves the organization off its partner.
partner.grantsDescription: Access your agreement with {partner} provides: one read-only area each, ending within a year. Partner staff never change anything through a grant, and every grant is in the audit log.

domains.title: Domain setup
domains.description: Custom Atlas and Gateway domains go live through Vercel, which checks your DNS and issues the TLS certificate. Sending domains are verified by Resend with SPF and DKIM; publish the DMARC record as well.
domains.none: Add a custom domain above to set it up here.
domains.name: Name
domains.checked: Check requested. It can take a few minutes.

certificates.title: Deletion certificates
certificates.description: Certificates for organizations you owned whose data was deleted. Each one was also emailed to you.
certificates.row: {org}: deleted on {date}, {rows} records and {files} stored files
certificates.preparing: {org}: deleted on {date}. The certificate is being prepared.

billing.trialBody: {org} is on a 14-day Pro trial until {date}, with no card. Add a card to stay on Pro. Otherwise it moves to the Access plan, and no data is deleted.
billing.pastDueBody: A payment failed on {since}. Update the payment method by {date} to keep full access.
billing.readOnlyBody: A payment failed on {since}, and the organization became read-only on {date}. Update the payment method to restore full access. No data has been deleted.
billing.notConnected: Online payment is not connected yet. Contact support to add a card or update the payment method.

home.trial: {org} is on a Pro trial until {date}.
